metadata.description: biblio's Claude Code skills, versioned with the biblio CLI they call (uv tool install "biblio-tools[zotero,docling]").

plugins.name: biblio
plugins.description: Find or convert a paper's full text, answer from it with claims whose quotes are checked against the text, and bring papers in from Zotero. Needs the biblio CLI.

plugins.name: biblio-kb
plugins.description: (beta) A project knowledge wiki built from papers with checked quotes, paper scrutiny with a blind second reader, and batch intake. Install with the biblio plugin.
